sentences.en: Seeds need germination operation to germinate.
sentences.zh: 种子需要适宜的条件才能发芽。

sentences.en: The farmer carefully monitors the germination process in his greenhouse.
sentences.zh: 农民仔细地监控温室里种子的发芽过程。

sentences.en: Different soil types can affect the rate of germination for seeds.
sentences.zh: 不同的土壤类型会影响种子的发芽速度。
